novenas.title: St Anthony Novena
novenas.about: [Placeholder] A nine-day prayer. Real description comes from your sheet.

blocks.text: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen. Today, on day 1 of this novena, we turn our hearts to trust, and we ask St Anthony to pray with us.

Lord God, you hear every quiet word we bring to you. Grant us the grace of trust today. Where we are weary, give us strength; where we are afraid, give us peace; where we are alone, remind us that you are near.

St Anthony, you walked the road of faith before us. Stand beside us now as we place our worries in your hands. Teach us to wait without fear, to ask without doubt, and to give thanks before we see the answer.
Lord, hear our prayer on this day of trust. Through the intercession of St Anthony, bless us and those we love, today and always. Amen.
